name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2026-05-14, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 3.96 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
